item.title: Watch Peter on S.W.A.T, Season 1, Episode 11, “K-Town”
item.description: In case you missed Peter on last night’s episode of S.W.A.T., you can watch it in its entirety here. Be sure to tune in on Thursday nights at 10/9c on CBS and catch Peter in his weekly role as Michael Plank. There is much to his character that has yet to be revealed.

item.title: Peter Is A Judge At The 2018 Mammoth Film Festival

item.title: Peter Filming “Running With The Devil”.
item.description: Peter is currently filming Running With The Devil in Bogota, Colombia with Nicholas Cage. He previously was in the country while filming The Damned. We have some photos from the movie for you to enjoy and will be adding video shortly. Details on the movie are upcoming.
